gizmo.title: Nchọta okwu
gizmo.description: Grid mkpụrụedemede nwere okwu zoro ezo. Ndị mmụta na-emetụ mkpụrụedemede mbụ na nke ikpeazụ nke okwu ọ bụla. Ọ na-akụzi ịhụ otu e si asụpe okwu, ọ bụghị ihe ọ pụtara.

configure.title: Aha
configure.description: Ihe a na-ajụ ndị mmụta ka ha chọta, e gosiri n'isi.

configure.title: Okwu
configure.description: Okwu a ga-ezo. A na-ahapụ oghere na akara edemede na grid. A na-edepụta okwu na-adabaghị mgbe ị na-edezi, a na-ahapụkwa ha maka ndị mmụta.

advanced.title: Nha grid
advanced.description: Mkpụrụedemede n'akụkụ ọ bụla, 4 ruo 16. Hapụ ya efu ka o kwekọọ n'okwu kacha ogologo (ruo 12). Karịa 12 na-akpụgharị n'akụkụ na ekwentị.

advanced.title: Okwu n'akụkụ
advanced.description: Zoo kwa okwu n'akụkụ. Siri ike karịa.

advanced.title: Okwu azụ azụ
advanced.description: Zoo kwa okwu e dere azụ azụ. Siri ike karịa.

advanced.title: Agba ntụpọ
advanced.description: Agba nhọrọ maka akara isi, mkpụrụedemede mbụ ahọpụtara na bọtịnụ.
